description: User provides a complete Figma URL and asks for verification against the running app.
prompt: Can you verify my doctor feature implementation matches the Figma designs? Here's the link: https://figma.com/design/abc123XYZ/SAMM-Mobile?node-id=1-2721. There are 3 screens: the menu (node 1-2721), the doctor list (node 1-2564), and the doctor detail (node 1-2767). The app is running on iOS.
expected_behavior: Extracts fileKey 'abc123XYZ' and converts node-id dashes to colons (1:2721, 1:2564, 1:2767)
Fetches all 3 Figma screenshots in parallel using mcp__figma__get_screenshot
Takes an initial app screenshot to confirm the app is running
Navigates to each screen via tapping and takes screenshots
Produces a per-screen comparison report with MATCH/PARTIAL MATCH/MISMATCH status

description: User asks for visual comparison but does not provide any Figma URL or nodeIds.
prompt: I just finished implementing the patient screens. Can you compare them against the Figma designs to make sure everything looks right?
expected_behavior: Recognizes this is a visual QA task and triggers the skill
Does NOT attempt to fetch Figma screenshots without fileKey/nodeId
Asks the user for the Figma URL or fileKey + nodeIds
Also asks which screens map to which Figma frames
Asks about any planned deviations from the design

description: User provides nodeIds directly, references a plan document, and lists planned deviations.
prompt:
Time for visual QA. The Figma file key is 'K9mzPL2wQ'. Screens to verify:
- Settings screen -> node 4:112
- Profile edit -> node 4:245
- Notification preferences -> node 4:389

Planned deviations:
1. The 'Delete Account' button is not implemented yet (out of scope for v1)
2. Avatar upload uses a placeholder icon instead of the camera icon in Figma

The plan doc is at docs/settings-feature-plan.md. Running on iOS simulator.
expected_behavior: Uses fileKey 'K9mzPL2wQ' and the three nodeIds directly (no URL parsing needed)
Reads docs/settings-feature-plan.md to understand the implementation scope
Fetches all 3 Figma screenshots in parallel
Records the 2 planned deviations so they are reported as 'Planned Deviation' not bugs
Navigates the app through all 3 screens, taking screenshots
In the comparison report, the missing Delete Account button and placeholder avatar icon are listed under 'Planned Deviations' not 'Differences'
Produces a final summary with an overall PASS if all non-planned differences are acceptable
